content:
踏上《魔法探險》的驚奇旅程，這是一款沉浸式的《當個創世神》模組包，融合了原始洞穴的刺激、奇趣小工具、可愛絨毛玩偶以及一系列萌系生物。內含如Create、Electrodynamic和AE2等熱門模組，本模組包提供獨特且迷人的遊戲體驗。

![已更新至Alex's Cave 2.0](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f4814b8a80b8389d18706bbfd3e801da8d76d90f_0.webp)
![火山爆發更新現已上線](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/354df0b7e9517e3d77d94248707890435549e0ee.png)
已更新至Alex's Cave 2.0+

**同時包含冰與火之歌、植物魔法與~~毀滅~~！**

## 適用於MC 1.20的全方位模組包，內容涵蓋：
- **探索**
    - [Alex's Cave](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves) 與 [Alex's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-mobs)
    - [冰與火之歌](https://modrinth.com/mod/ice-and-fire-dragons)
    - [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra)、[BOP](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty) 與 [Mystic's Biomes](https://modrinth.com/mod/mystics-biomes)
    - [Ribbits](https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits)、[Yung's Better Structures](https://modrinth.com/user/YUNGNICKYOUNG) 及眾多建築結構！
- **科技**
    - [IE](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersiveengineering)、[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) 及其擴充模組
    - [AE2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2)、[Electrodynamic](https://modrinth.com/mod/electrodynamics) 與 [Nuclear Science](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuclear-science)
- **趣味與小工具**
    - [I Wanna Skate](https://modrinth.com/mod/i-wanna-skate)、[Artifacts](https://modrinth.com/mod/artifacts) 與 [Simple Hats](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-hats)
    - [Camera](https://modrinth.com/mod/camera-mod)、[WebDisplays](https://modrinth.com/mod/webdisplays)、[Immersive Melodies](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-melodies) 及 [Tempad](https://modrinth.com/mod/tempad)
- **裝飾**
    - [Furnish](https://modrinth.com/mod/furnish-furniture)、[AMW絨毛玩偶](https://modrinth.com/mod/a-man-with-plushies)、[Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries) 與 [Handcrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/handcrafted)

另包含10多個效能優化模組，僅需4GB記憶體即可流暢遊玩，但v2.0版本建議配置接近5GB記憶體。
